source: PubMed via the project's PubMed connector; full text from PubMed Central
query_bank: SELUMETINIB AND (blood-brain barrier OR cerebrospinal fluid OR brain penetration OR CNS penetration)
SELUMETINIB AND ("brain-to-plasma" OR "brain to plasma" OR Kpuu OR "unbound brain" OR "CSF concentration")
scope: 20 active moieties normalised from the 30 shortlist drug labels (salt forms collapsed)
caveat: sentences are regex-selected and NOT adjudicated; direction is a keyword split, not a judgement of the finding. Every claim carries its PMID, DOI and access level so a human verifies it. Abstract-only claims are weaker evidence than full-text ones by design.
attribution_rule: the drug name or a known synonym must appear in the sentence itself; 73% of regex-matched sentences fail this and are retained but flagged, because a paper retrieved for one drug routinely discusses others
retry_note: the first pass lost REGORAFENIB and SUNITINIB to a metadata KeyError on 12-16 id batches and showed them as zero-evidence; re-running in batches of 4 recovered both. Six full-text KeyErrors also recovered on retry. Two calls still fail and are listed.
